decks.notes: This deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing cards that put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. Cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Unholy Heat help to control the opponent's hand and board state, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf deliver quick and consistent damage. The synergy between cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Liliana of the Veil adds another layer of disruption to the deck, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The land base is optimized for consistency and the ability to cast a variety of spells.

The main concept of this UR Control deck is to maintain control of the game by utilizing a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage spells like Archmage's Charm. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually gaining advantage through powerful cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Murktide Regent. By controlling the board and the opponent's resources, the deck looks to establish dominance and eventually win the game through incremental advantage. Key cards like Blood Moon and Dress Down can also disrupt opponent's strategies and give the deck an edge in certain matchups.

This deck utilizes the synergy between Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Colossus Hammer to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo. Esper Sentinel and Teferi, Time Raveler provide disruption and card advantage, while Ornithopter and Springleaf Drum enable fast mana generation. Sigarda's Aid allows for instant equipping of equipment, and Nettlecyst and Kaldra Compleat offer additional strong threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and lethal equipment-based strategy, utilizing various cards to protect and support the combo.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of cards to quickly ramp up mana and search for key pieces to bring out Primeval Titan. This allows for explosive plays and the ability to search for specific lands or creatures to further enhance the board state. The key strategy is to use Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and take advantage of the extra mana generated by the Titan, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with large creatures and powerful land interactions.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful equipment and aggressive creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By efficiently equipping creatures with swords and utilizing cards like Solitude and Lightning Helix for removal and disruption, the deck aims to maintain board control while pressuring the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ranger-Captain of Eos provides card advantage and resilience against various strategic matchups. The deck's strategy revolves around quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats and powerful equipment.

The deck focuses on using cards like Faithful Mending, Persist, and Unburial Rites to quickly reanimate powerful threats like Archon of Cruelty while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Thoughtseize. The addition of Drown in the Loch, Prismatic Ending, and Void Rend helps to control the opponent's board while setting up the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control elements, creating a dominant board presence and forcing the opponent to react to its threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through enchantments and utilizing the Enchantress ability to draw cards. By ramping with Utopia Sprawl and Sanctum Weaver, the deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and lock down the opponent with cards like Blood Moon and Solitary Confinement. Sterling Grove provides protection for key enchantments, while Destiny Spinner offers resilience against counterspells. The deck can also disrupt the opponent's mana base with On Thin Ice and Prismatic Ending. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent through enchantment synergy and efficient control.

The focus of this Modern Aggro Death's Shadow deck is on quickly reducing your own life total to power up Death's Shadow and other high-impact threats, while disrupting your opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. The deck aims to control the board early on with efficient threats like Ragavan and Dragon's Rage Channeler, and make use of cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By carefully managing your life total and resources, this deck looks to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize, using powerful finishers like Kroxa and The Royal Scions.

The deck focuses on quickly building up +1/+1 counters on creatures using cards like Hardened Scales and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. This allows for explosive plays with cards like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, while also gaining advantage with cards like The Ozolith and Hangarback Walker. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for artifacts, while Inkmoth Nexus can serve as an alternate win condition with infect damage. The deck is able to apply early pressure and adapt to different game situations with cards like Welding Jar and Animation Module.

This deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies by slowing them down with tax effects and land destruction while deploying aggressive threats. The deck utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Leonin Arbiter to disrupt opponents' plans, while using Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play quickly. Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition provide additional value and removal options, while Solitude offers efficient creature removal. The deck also includes equipment like Batterskull and Sword of Fire and Ice to provide additional power to its creatures. Overall, the deck combines aggression with disruption to control the game.

The deck focuses on casting spells with a cmc of 3 or less to trigger cascade effects, allowing you to cast powerful spells for free from the top of your library. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with an aggressive creature base and disruptive spells like Force of Negation while constantly putting pressure on them with cards like Crashing Footfalls. With a mix of card advantage, tempo plays, and fast threats, the deck aims to maintain board presence and control the flow of the game to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Counterspell and Archmage's Charm. The deck aims to quickly finish off the opponent with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also keeping the deck's velocity high with cards like Consider and Expressive Iteration. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and efficient in dealing damage to the opponent.
